model.name: All Tasks owned by the owner profile — scoped backfill that preserves every structural parent (Task and non-Task)
model.description: Tron's Set-as-Current on Task 40.1 returned 403 'owner only' because that Task's ownerIor is null. His rule: EVERY Task is owned by his profile (05e58f81 'Marcel Donges'), so the owner-gate passes. BUT ownerIor is OVERLOADED: on a Task it must be the profile owner, yet on CHAIN units it is the STRUCTURAL PARENT (Impl->Method, ChangeRequest->Test — today's re-parent). MEASURED (525 Tasks): 195 new-schema (structural Sprint in `parent`, ownerIor null = safe to set) + 330 OLD-schema (structural Sprint held IN ownerIor, no `parent` field). So a naive ownerIor:=profile would CLOBBER 330 Task->Sprint structural links = the same graph destruction the non-Task trap warns of, but INSIDE the Task class. The backfill must set Task.ownerIor=owner-profile for all 525 WHILE preserving every Task->Sprint parent, and touch NO non-Task ownerIor.
model.crossRefNote: R40.17 owner-gate (the 403 Set-as-Current path); R40.10 owner identity via profile (05e58f81 = the same owner-profile-unit that approvedBy uses). The re-parent we did today (CR->Test) is the exact ownerIor-is-structural case the scope-AC must not disturb.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every ior:class:Task has ownerIor = the owner profile 05e58f81 (Marcel Donges), so the Set-as-Current owner-gate passes for the owner (T40.1's 403-while-null is resolved).

The backfill modifies ownerIor on ior:class:Task units ONLY. NO non-Task unit's ownerIor is modified — Impl->Method, ChangeRequest->Test, Requirement->Sprint etc. are STRUCTURAL parents, left untouched.
A seeded NON-Task unit whose ownerIor would change under the backfill => RED. (Without this, a correct-looking backfill silently destroys the traceability graph.)

Where a Task currently carries its Sprint in ownerIor (measured: 330 old-schema Tasks, no `parent`), the Sprint structural parent is FIRST relocated into the Task's `parent` field, so it is NOT lost when ownerIor becomes the profile. Post-backfill EVERY Task has ownerIor=owner-profile AND parent=its Sprint AND remains in Sprint.tasks[].
A Task that loses its Sprint linkage after the backfill (parent unset AND absent from Sprint.tasks[]) => RED.

Gated dry-run + before/after counts (525 Tasks: 195 null->owned, 330 Sprint-in-ownerIor->parent-relocated-then-owned), reversible, ambiguous->flag; the owner profile uuid is not leaked into logs beyond the unit field.

The owner value is the owner profile UNIT (05e58f81), resolved SINGLE-SOURCE (profileUuidOf(owner) / the owner profile), not a literal scattered across call sites — the owner-gate reads the same source it is backfilled from.

measured.nonTask_ownerIor_is_structural_parent: Test 1029 / Sprint 876 / Class 635 / Impl 586 / Method 576 / Requirement 249 / UseCase 53 ... = the overload

model.flagToArchitect: The non-null Task owners are SPRINTS (structural), NOT profiles — the directive's 'other uuids in the non-null set' are structural parents. 330 old-schema Tasks need Sprint relocated to `parent` BEFORE ownerIor:=profile, or the Task->Sprint graph is clobbered.
